scope: IMU diagnostic display smoothing, explicit level reference, delivery recovery and recording quality

saved_recording_replay.note: Smoothing reduces sample-to-sample display jumps; these statistics do not demonstrate improved physical attitude accuracy. Initial angles were not treated as sensor bias.

behavior.display_filter: EMA of corrected acceleration in Pi sample-receipt time; tau 0.2 seconds
behavior.level_zero: User asserts level surface, stationary 2 second window, fresh recording; display only
